article.statement: For a chamber path p with consecutive crossing elements v₁,…,v_m and product v_p, p is geodesic if and only if ℓ(v_p)=Σ_i ℓ(v_i). Geodesic means having the minimum number of crossings between its endpoints.
article.locator: Proposition 3.29, printed pp. 13–14; path and geodesic conventions in §3.4, printed p. 13.

portal.statement: The same equivalence for finite-rank relative chamber paths, including the one-chamber path with empty product and sum. Its suppliers include the length/half-space criterion and translation between relative arrangements.

translation.type:
∀ {S : Type*} [Finite S] (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (J : Set S),
  let W := CoxeterMatrix.Group M
  let cs := CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem M
  let Label := { p : W × Set S //
    Set.image (fun u : W => u * p.1) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J : Set W) =
      Set.image (fun u : W => p.1 * u) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs p.2 : Set W) ∧
    CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep cs p.2 p.1 }
  let component : Set S → S → Set S := fun I a =>
    { b | b ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b }
  let Step := { e : Label × S // e.2 ∉ e.1.val.2 ∧
    Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component e.1.val.2 e.2)) }
  let crossing := fun e : Step =>
    SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs e.val.1.val.2 e.val.2 e.property.1 e.property.2
  let path : Label → Label → List Step → Prop := fun p q es =>
    List.foldr
      (fun e tail r => r = e.val.1.val ∧ tail ((crossing e).2.2 e.val.1.val.1))
      (fun r => r = q.val) es p.val
  ∀ (p q : Label) (es : List Step), path p q es →
    ((∀ fs : List Step, path p q fs → List.length es ≤ List.length fs) ↔
      CoxeterSystem.length cs (List.prod (List.map (fun e => (crossing e).1) es)) =
        List.sum (List.map (fun e => CoxeterSystem.length cs (crossing e).1) es))

The supplied defect report was checked in full and does not identify Proposition 3.29's statement as defective. Finite rank is user-directed, not a reported correction; Coxeter type and J remain arbitrary, with no finiteness assumption on W or W_J. Labels represent relative chambers via ChamberLabelling, and Step records the prescribed adjacent crossing via SimpleWallCrossings and AdjacentWallFormula. The path predicate enforces consecutive endpoints, and geodesicity explicitly minimizes the number of crossings among all paths with those endpoints. An empty crossing list represents a one-chamber path, with identity product and zero sum.

items.title: Tits cone intersection and relative arrangement

article.statement: For J ⊆ Γ₀, let Θ_J = {f ∈ V*: f(α_j)=0 for every j∈J}. Define Cone(J)=Cone∩Θ_J, taking its interior in Θ_J. Define Φ^J={α∈Φ: Θ_J is not contained in H_α}=Φ\Φ_J and H^J={H_α∩Θ_J: α∈Φ^J_+}, counting coincident traces once.
article.locator: §3.1, printed p. 7, equations (3.1)–(3.3); §1.1.2, printed p. 2.

portal.statement: The same relative cone, roots and distinct hyperplane traces, explicitly using finite Γ₀ and the induced coordinate Euclidean topology. Neither W nor W_J is required to be finite.
portal.locator: Definition and Source notes of def-relative-cone-artin-tits-normalisers.

items.title: Local finiteness in the relative interior

article.statement: Every u∈Cone(J)° belongs to an open ball in Cone(J) meeting only finitely many members of H^J. Consequently (Cone(J)°,H^J) is locally finite.
article.locator: Proposition 3.6, printed p. 9; Remark 3.7 distinguishes this from ambient local finiteness.

portal.statement: For finite Γ₀ and arbitrary J, every point of the relative interior has a relative Euclidean ball contained in Cone(J) meeting finitely many distinct relative hyperplanes. No spherical-type hypothesis is imposed.

items.title: Minimal coset labels classify relative chambers

article.statement: The map (x,I)↦xC_I bijects the chambers of (Cone(J)°,H^J) with Cham(J)={(x,I): W_Jx=xW_I and x has minimum length in xW_I}. Here C_I={f∈Θ_I: f(α_i)>0 for i∉I}.
article.locator: Theorem 3.9 and equation (3.10), printed pp. 9–10; equation (3.2), printed p. 7.

portal.statement: The same chamber-labelling bijection under the finite-rank geometric convention, for arbitrary Coxeter type and arbitrary J. The algebraic label set itself is available at arbitrary rank.
portal.locator: Statement, Facts & Assumptions and Source notes of thm-chamber-labelling-artin-tits-normalisers.

items.title: Elementary crossing elements from spherical components

article.statement: For a∉I, let D=[I,a] be the component containing a in the diagram induced on I∪{a}. When W_D is finite, define v_{a,I}=w_{D\{a}}w_D, K=(I∪{a})\{ι_D(a)}, and ω_{a,I}(x,I)=(xv_{a,I},K). The opposition permutation satisfies w_Dα_i=−α_{ι_D(i)}. Finiteness is required of W_D, not of W_I or W_{I∪{a}}.
article.locator: Notation 3.13 and equations (3.14)–(3.15), printed p. 10; Notation 2.5 and equation (2.6), printed p. 5.

portal.statement: The same component-based construction on algebraic labels. Its definition initially gives a pair in W×P(Γ₀); preservation of chamber labels and geometric adjacency require subsequent results.

items.title: Adjacent chambers and inverse elementary crossings

article.statement: For adjacent chambers (x,I),(y,K), the common wall has unique describing indices a∉I and a′∉K, with I∪{a}=K∪{a′}. Their crossing components coincide and are spherical. The crossings satisfy ω_{a,I}(x,I)=(y,K), ω_{a′,K}(y,K)=(x,I), and v_{a,I}v_{a′,K}=v_{a′,K}v_{a,I}=1.
article.locator: Proposition 3.17 and following sentence, printed p. 11.

portal.statement: In finite rank, the common closed wall is the closure of xC_{I∪{a}} and of yC_{K∪{a′}}. The describing indices, finite crossing components, prescribed opposite labels and inverse products have the stated properties. Neither W_I nor W_{I∪{a}} is assumed finite.

items.title: Finite crossing paths connect relative chambers

article.statement: Any two chambers are related by a finite sequence of simple wall crossings.
article.locator: Lemma 3.20(3) and Remark 3.22, printed p. 11; Remark 3.8, printed p. 9.

portal.statement: For a finite-rank Coxeter system and arbitrary J, any two relative chambers are joined by finitely many component-based simple crossings. The empty sequence is allowed for equal endpoints.

items.title: Free normaliser-quotient action on chamber labels

article.statement: For ḡ∈N(W,J)=Norm_W(W_J)/W_J and any representative g, let y be the minimum-length element of gxW_I. Then ḡ·(x,I)=(y,I). Labels with the same second component form one orbit; the action is free and commutes with each defined adjacent crossing ω_{a,I}, preserving its index.
article.locator: Lemma 3.24(1)–(4), printed p. 12; underlying linear action in Lemma 3.23, printed p. 12.

portal.statement: The same free action, fibre-orbit description and crossing equivariance in the finite-rank relative chamber geometry, without requiring W or W_J finite.

items.title: Geodesicity equals Coxeter-length additivity

article.statement: For a chamber path p with consecutive crossing elements v₁,…,v_m and product v_p, p is geodesic if and only if ℓ(v_p)=Σ_i ℓ(v_i). Geodesic means having the minimum number of crossings between its endpoints.
article.locator: Proposition 3.29, printed pp. 13–14; path and geodesic conventions in §3.4, printed p. 13.

portal.statement: The same equivalence for finite-rank relative chamber paths, including the one-chamber path with empty product and sum. Its suppliers include the length/half-space criterion and translation between relative arrangements.

items.title: Brink–Howlett groupoid with the article's composition convention

article.statement: Fix a Coxeter diagram Γ, its Coxeter group W and J⊆Γ₀. An associate I of J has W_I conjugate to W_J. The groupoid BH(J) has these associates as objects and Hom_BH(I,K)={x∈W: x{α_k:k∈K}={α_i:i∈I}}. If x:I→K and y:K→L, their left-to-right composite is xy:I→L.
article.locator: §4.1, definition preceding Remark 4.1, printed p. 15; associates in Definition 2.7, printed p. 5.

portal.statement: The same small connected groupoid, with arrows tagged by source and target and multiplication read left to right. No finite-rank or spherical-type restriction is imposed.

items.title: Elementary crossings are Brink–Howlett arrows

article.statement: If I is an associate of J, a∉I and W_[I,a] is finite, then v_{a,I}∈Hom_BH(I,(I∪{a})\{ι_[I,a](a)}).
article.locator: Lemma 4.2, printed p. 15.

portal.statement: At arbitrary rank, the prescribed target K is an associate of J and v_{a,I}{α_k:k∈K}={α_i:i∈I}. Only the crossing component is required to be spherical.

items.title: Singleton-arrow groupoid on chamber labels

article.statement: The groupoid BH̃(J) has objects Cham(J), with Hom((x,I),(y,K)) the singleton labelled x⁻¹y. Composition multiplies labels on the right. For adjacent chambers its arrow is labelled by their elementary crossing element.
article.locator: Definition 4.3 and following paragraph, printed p. 15.

portal.statement: The algebraic singleton-arrow construction applies at arbitrary rank, retaining endpoint tags. Its geometric chamber and adjacent-crossing interpretation additionally uses finite rank, without assuming W, W_I or W_{I∪{a}} finite.

items.title: Adjacent crossings generate the universal wall groupoid

article.statement: For any chamber labels (x,I),(y,K), there is a finite crossing path p between them whose product v_p equals x⁻¹y. Thus the adjacent-crossing arrows generate BH̃(J). The path need not be unique.
article.locator: Proposition 4.4, printed p. 16.

portal.statement: The same factorization through finite paths in the finite-rank relative-interior arrangement, with endpoint-tagged arrows and the zero-crossing case included.

items.title: Chamber labels and prescribed-source arrow lifting

article.statement: For associates I,K of J: (1) chamber labels (x,I),(y,K) satisfy x⁻¹y∈Hom_BH(I,K); (2) if w∈Hom_BH(I,K) and (x,I)∈Cham(J), then (xw,K)∈Cham(J), and w labels the arrow upstairs from (x,I) to (xw,K).
article.locator: Proposition 4.6(1)–(2), printed p. 16.

portal.statement: The same assertions are stated with finite-rank hypotheses and geometric chamber identification. The main covering entry separately supplies an arbitrary-rank algebraic correspondence using canonical simple systems.

items.title: Theorem 1.3 / 4.7: universal covering, wall crossings and deck quotient

article.statement: Let Γ be a Coxeter diagram with Coxeter group W and J⊆Γ₀. The functor F:BH̃(J)→BH(J), defined by F(x,I)=I and F(x⁻¹y)=x⁻¹y, is a universal groupoid covering with Deck(F)≅N(W,J). Preserve also Theorem 1.3's geometric content: its upstairs objects are the chambers of (Cone(J)°,H^J), its generating morphisms are simple crossings between adjacent chambers, and BH(J) is obtained as the N(W,J)-quotient of BH̃(J). No spherical-type restriction on W or W_J is stated.
article.locator: Theorem 1.3 and following paragraph, printed p. 2; Theorem 4.7, printed pp. 16–17; Definition 4.3, printed p. 15; Proposition 4.4, printed p. 16.

portal.statement: At arbitrary rank, the algebraic label groupoid covers BH(J) universally, has deck group N(W,J), and has quotient isomorphic to BH(J). Its geometric chamber identification, adjacent-generator interpretation and generation assertion explicitly use finite rank. Neither W nor W_J is required finite. This scope distinction remains explicit and is not substituted for the original requested statement.
portal.locator: Statement, External input and Source notes of thm-universal-brink-howlett-cover-artin-tits-normalisers.

items.title: Length-additive elementary expressions

article.statement: For w∈Hom_BH(I,K), a standard expression is a finite composable product w=v_{a₁,I₁}⋯v_{a_m,I_m}, starting at I and ending at K, with ℓ(w)=Σ_iℓ(v_{a_i,I_i}). Its expression length is m. Existence and independence of the expression are subsequent assertions, not assumptions of this definition.
article.locator: Definition 4.9, printed p. 17.

portal.statement: The same definition at arbitrary rank. Each elementary factor requires its crossing component spherical. The empty expression represents an identity. The notation ℓ_BH(w) is introduced only after existence and invariance of factor count are established.

items.title: Standard expressions lift to geodesic paths

article.statement: A composable sequence of simple wall crossings is a geodesic path exactly when its product is a standard expression in BH. Every w∈Hom_BH(I,K) has a standard expression; its lift from (x,I) ends at (xw,K).
article.locator: Lemma 4.10 and equations (4.11)–(4.12), printed p. 18.

portal.statement: In finite rank, each standard expression has a unique geodesic lift from any prescribed chamber of its source type. For specified crossings, target-source compatibility is required. The empty expression corresponds to a one-chamber path. This geometric supplier alone does not establish arbitrary-rank existence.

items.title: Arbitrary-rank existence and parallel-class factor count

article.statement: No standalone article statement gives the parallel-class formula selected here. This is a portal helper supporting existence of standard expressions and invariance of their factor count; the parent article assertions are Lemma 4.10 and Corollary 4.13.
article.locator: Parent results: Lemma 4.10 and Corollary 4.13, printed p. 18. The formula m=|C(w)| is not attributed to an article lemma.

portal.statement: Every article morphism w has a standard expression. If an expression has m factors, then m=|C(w)|, using the opposite root-action arrow with the same label. Here C(w) is the finite set of real parallel classes contained in its positive inversion set. Its declared algebraic suppliers allow arbitrary rank.
portal.locator: Statement and Facts & Assumptions of lem-author-b19d43a8e520-bh-standard-factor-count; source references are empty, so article attribution is only through the stated parent results.

items.title: Elementary generation and invariance of standard length

article.statement: BH(J) is generated by v_{a,I} for associates I and a∉I with W_[I,a] finite. Any two standard expressions of the same morphism, with the same source, have the same number of factors.
article.locator: Corollary 4.13(1)–(2), printed p. 18.

portal.statement: The same generation and equal-factor-count assertions. Its current proof suppliers use the arbitrary-rank StandardFactorCount endpoint rather than relying on finite-rank chamber geometry.

items.title: Finite relative longest element inside an arbitrary system

article.statement: No standalone article lemma states this full construction and inversion-set formula. It is a portal helper for Lemma 4.15: finite Φ_{I∪{a,b}}\Φ_I allows construction inside the union of the components meeting {a,b}, without making I or the ambient system spherical.
article.locator: Parent result: Lemma 4.15 and equation (4.16), printed p. 19; related inverse characterization in Remark 4.17, printed p. 19.

portal.statement: At arbitrary rank, let a,b∉I be distinct, T=I∪{a,b}, and Φ_T\Φ_I finite. Let D be the union of components of T meeting {a,b}. Then W_D is finite. For r=w_Dw_{D∩I}, rΠ_I=Π_K for an associate K⊆T; q=r⁻¹ is an article morphism I→K and N(q)=Φ_T⁺\Φ_I⁺, where N(x)=Φ⁺∩xΦ⁻.

items.title: Minimal common prefix and its two standard expressions

article.statement: Let I be an associate of J and a,b∉I distinct, with |Φ_{I∪{a,b}}\Φ_I|<∞. There is an associate K and v_{a,b,I}:I→K left-divisible by v_{a,I},v_{b,I}, with exactly two standard expressions of equal factor count, starting respectively with these generators. Every BH morphism from I having both generators as length-additive left divisors has v_{a,b,I} as a left divisor. Thus this common multiple is minimal for left divisibility and standard-expression length.
article.locator: Lemma 4.15(1)–(2) and equation (4.16), printed p. 19.

portal.statement: The same theorem with its finite relative-root hypothesis retained. It chooses v_{a,b,I}=(w_Dw_{D∩I})⁻¹ using FiniteRelativeLongest. The declared supporting endpoints separately establish elementary prefixes, simultaneous-prefix minimality and exactly two standard words.

items.title: Atomic braid relations and contextual replacements

article.statement: Under Lemma 4.15's hypotheses, equating the two standard expressions of v_{a,b,I} in (4.16) is an atomic braid relation.
article.locator: Definition 4.18, Lemma 4.15 and equation (4.16), printed p. 19.

portal.statement: For distinct a,b outside an associate I with finite Φ_{I∪{a,b}}\Φ_I, the equality of the two supplied standard expressions defines the atomic braid relation. In the main theorem a move replaces either side inside a composable expression, retaining the surrounding factors.
portal.locator: Definition of def-atomic-braid-artin-tits-normalisers; contextual use in the Statement of thm-atomic-matsumoto-artin-tits-normalisers.

items.title: Theorem 1.4 / 4.21: Atomic Matsumoto

article.statement: Let Γ be a Coxeter diagram, J⊆Γ₀, BH(J) its Brink–Howlett groupoid, and I,K associates of J. Any two standard expressions of w∈Hom_BH(I,K) are related by a sequence of atomic braid relations. Preserve the arbitrary-Coxeter-type scope: neither W, W_J, nor the enlarged parabolics W_{I∪{a}} are globally assumed finite. Standard expressions and atomic braid relations have exactly the meanings of Definitions 4.9 and 4.18.
article.locator: Theorem 1.4, printed p. 3; Theorem 4.21 and Remark 4.22, printed p. 20; Definitions 4.9 and 4.18, printed pp. 17 and 19.

portal.statement: For a Coxeter system without rank or type restriction, arbitrary J and associates I,K, any two finite length-additive elementary expressions of the same morphism w:I→K are connected by finitely many atomic braid relations. The finite relative-root condition needed for a two-generator relation is derived from the common prefixes; it is not added as a hypothesis of the main theorem.
portal.locator: Statement, Facts & Assumptions and External input of thm-atomic-matsumoto-artin-tits-normalisers.

BrinkHowlettGroupoid.type: ∀ {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S), CategoryTheory.Groupoid { I : Set S // ∃ w : W, Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj w)) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs I) = CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J }
BrinkHowlettGroupoid.value:
by
  intro S W inst M cs J
  let roots : Set S → Set (Finsupp S Real) :=
    fun I => Set.image (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) I
  exact {
    Hom := fun I K => { w : W //
      Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs w) (roots K.val) = roots I.val }
    id := fun I => ⟨1, by simp⟩
    comp := fun {I K L} x y => ⟨x.val * y.val, by
      calc
        Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs (x.val * y.val)) (roots L.val)
            = Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val)
                (Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs y.val) (roots L.val)) := by
                  simp only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, Set.image_image]
        _ = roots I.val := by rw [y.property, x.property]⟩
    id_comp := fun x => Subtype.ext (one_mul x.val)
    comp_id := fun x => Subtype.ext (mul_one x.val)
    assoc := fun x y z => Subtype.ext (mul_assoc x.val y.val z.val)
    inv := fun {I K} x => ⟨x.val⁻¹, by
      calc
        Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val⁻¹) (roots I.val)
            = Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val⁻¹)
                (Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val) (roots K.val)) :=
                  congrArg (Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val⁻¹)) x.property.symm
        _ = roots K.val := by
          simp only [Set.image_image, Representation.inv_self_apply, Set.image_id']⟩
    inv_comp := fun x => Subtype.ext (inv_mul_cancel x.val)
    comp_inv := fun x => Subtype.ext (mul_inv_cancel x.val)
  }

SimpleWallCrossings.type: ∀ (S : Type _) (W : Type _) [Group W] (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (I : Set S) (a : S) (_ha : a ∉ I), let D : Set S := {b | b ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b}; Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs D) → W × Set S × (W → W × Set S)
SimpleWallCrossings.value:
fun S W _inst M cs I a _ha =>
  let D : Set S := {b | b ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b}
  fun hD =>
    letI : Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs D) := hD
    let longest : (L : Set S) → L ⊆ D → W := fun L hL =>
      letI : Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs L) :=
        Finite.of_injective
          (fun w : CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs L => (⟨(w : W), (CoxeterSystem.parabolic_mono cs hL) w.property⟩ : CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs D))
          (fun _ _ h => Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs D => (z : W)) h))
      (Classical.choose (Finite.exists_max (fun w : CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs L => CoxeterSystem.length cs (w : W)))).val
    let wD := longest D (fun _ h => h)
    let opposition : Equiv D D :=
      @Classical.epsilon (Equiv D D) ⟨Equiv.refl D⟩ (fun e => ∀ i : D, CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs wD (Finsupp.single (i : S) (1 : Real)) = -Finsupp.single (e i : S) (1 : Real))
    let aD : D := ⟨a, ⟨Set.mem_insert a I, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩⟩
    let v := longest (D \ {a}) Set.sdiff_subset * wD
    let K : Set S := Set.insert a I \ {(opposition aD : S)}
    (v, K, fun x => (x * v, K))

  let leftDiv : W → W → Prop := fun u v => CoxeterSystem.length cs v = CoxeterSystem.length cs u + CoxeterSystem.length cs (u⁻¹ * v)

AtomicBraidRelations.value:
fun {S W} _inst {M} cs J =>
  let Obj := { L : Set S // ∃ g : W, Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g)) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs L) = CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J }
  let component : Set S → S → Set S := fun L a =>
    { b | b ∈ Set.insert a L ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a L ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a L ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b }
  let Atom := { p : Obj × S // p.2 ∉ p.1.val ∧ Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component p.1.val p.2)) }
  let crossing := fun e : Atom => SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs e.val.1.val e.val.2 e.property.1 e.property.2
  let composable : List Atom → Set S → Set S → Prop := fun es L K =>
    List.foldr
      (fun e tail N => N = e.val.1.val ∧ tail (crossing e).2.1)
      (fun N => N = K) es L
  let parabolicRoots : Set S → Set (Finsupp S Real) := fun L =>
    { α | ∃ u : W, u ∈ CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs L ∧ ∃ i : S, i ∈ L ∧
      CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs u (Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) = α }
  let braid : List Atom → List Atom → Prop := fun u v =>
    ∃ (L : Obj) (a b : S) (ha : a ∉ L.val) (hb : b ∉ L.val)
      (hab : a ≠ b)
      (hfin : Set.Finite (parabolicRoots (Set.insert a (Set.insert b L.val)) \ parabolicRoots L.val)),
      let h0 := TwoGeneratorMinimal cs J L a b ha hb hab hfin
      let hDa := Classical.choose h0
      let h1 := Classical.choose_spec h0
      let hDb := Classical.choose h1
      let h2 := Classical.choose_spec h1
      let K := Classical.choose h2
      let h3 := Classical.choose_spec h2
      let q := Classical.choose h3
      let h4 := Classical.choose_spec h3
      let ea := Classical.choose h4
      let eb := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec h4)
      (u = ea.val ∧ v = eb.val) ∨ (u = eb.val ∧ v = ea.val)
  fun es fs =>
    ∃ pre u v post : List Atom,
      braid u v ∧
      es = pre ++ u ++ post ∧
      fs = pre ++ v ++ post ∧
      ∃ L K : Obj, composable es L.val K.val ∧ composable fs L.val K.val

RelativeLocalFiniteness.type:
∀ {S : Type*} [Finite S] (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (J : Set S),
  letI : Fintype S := Fintype.ofFinite S
  let Θ := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.relativeSubspace J
  letI : TopologicalSpace Θ := TopologicalSpace.induced
    (fun f : Θ => ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates f.val)
    (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace (S → Real))
  let data := RelativeCone M J
  let cone : Set Θ := data.1
  let coneInterior : Set Θ := data.2.1
  let arrangement : Set (Submodule Real Θ) := data.2.2.2.2.2
  let ball : Θ → Real → Set Θ := fun u r =>
    { v | Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i : S =>
        (ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates v.val i -
         ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates u.val i) ^ 2) < r ^ 2 }
  (∀ u : Θ, u ∈ coneInterior → ∃ r : Real, 0 < r ∧
    ball u r ⊆ cone ∧
    Set.Finite { H : Submodule Real Θ | H ∈ arrangement ∧
      Set.Nonempty (ball u r ∩ (H : Set Θ)) }) ∧
  (∀ u : Θ, u ∈ coneInterior → ∃ U : Set Θ,
    IsOpen U ∧ u ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ coneInterior ∧
    Set.Finite { H : Submodule Real Θ | H ∈ arrangement ∧
      Set.Nonempty ((H : Set Θ) ∩ coneInterior) ∧
      Set.Nonempty (U ∩ (H : Set Θ)) })

ChamberLabelling.type:
∀ {S : Type*} [Finite S] (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (J : Set S),
  let Θ := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.relativeSubspace J
  letI : TopologicalSpace Θ := TopologicalSpace.induced
    (fun f : Θ => ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates f.val)
    (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace (S → Real))
  let data := RelativeCone M J
  let coneInterior : Set Θ := data.2.1
  let arrangement : Set (Submodule Real Θ) := data.2.2.2.2.2
  let complement : Set Θ := { f | f ∈ coneInterior ∧
    ∀ H : Submodule Real Θ, H ∈ arrangement → f ∉ (H : Set Θ) }
  let chambers : Set (Set Θ) := { C | ∃ f : Θ,
    f ∈ complement ∧ C = connectedComponentIn complement f }
  let labels : Set (CoxeterMatrix.Group M × Set S) := { p |
    Set.image (fun u : CoxeterMatrix.Group M => u * p.1)
      (CoxeterSystem.parabolic (CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem M) J : Set (CoxeterMatrix.Group M)) =
    Set.image (fun u : CoxeterMatrix.Group M => p.1 * u)
      (CoxeterSystem.parabolic (CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem M) p.2 : Set (CoxeterMatrix.Group M)) ∧
    CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep (CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem M) p.2 p.1 }
  let face : Set S → Set (ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Dual S) := fun I =>
    { f | f ∈ ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.relativeSubspace I ∧
      ∀ i : S, i ∉ I → 0 < ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates f i }
  let labelRegion : (CoxeterMatrix.Group M × Set S) → Set Θ := fun p =>
    { f | ∃ g : ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Dual S,
      g ∈ face p.2 ∧ ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualAction M p.1 g = f.val }
  Set.BijOn labelRegion labels chambers

AdjacentWallFormula.type:
∀ {S : Type*} [Finite S] (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (J : Set S),
  let W := CoxeterMatrix.Group M
  let cs := CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem M
  let Θ := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.relativeSubspace J
  letI : TopologicalSpace Θ := TopologicalSpace.induced
    (fun f : Θ => ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates f.val)
    (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace (S → Real))
  let arrangement : Set (Submodule Real Θ) := (RelativeCone M J).2.2.2.2.2
  let label : W → Set S → Prop := fun x I =>
    Set.image (fun u : W => u * x) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J : Set W) =
      Set.image (fun u : W => x * u) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs I : Set W) ∧
    CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep cs I x
  let face : Set S → Set (ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Dual S) := fun I =>
    { f | f ∈ ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.relativeSubspace I ∧
      ∀ i : S, i ∉ I → 0 < ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates f i }
  let region : W → Set S → Set Θ := fun x I =>
    { f | ∃ g : ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Dual S,
      g ∈ face I ∧ ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualAction M x g = f.val }
  let affineDimension : Set Θ → Nat := fun A =>
    Module.finrank Real (AffineSubspace.direction (affineSpan Real A))
  let wall : Set Θ → Set Θ → Prop := fun C F =>
    Set.Nonempty F ∧ ∃ H : Submodule Real Θ, H ∈ arrangement ∧
      F = closure C ∩ (H : Set Θ) ∧ affineDimension F + 1 = affineDimension C
  let component : Set S → S → Set S := fun I a =>
    { b | b ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b }
  ∀ (x y : W) (I K : Set S), label x I → label y K →
    ∀ F : Set Θ, region x I ≠ region y K → wall (region x I) F → wall (region y K) F →
    ∃ (a a' : S) (ha : a ∉ I) (ha' : a' ∉ K),
      F = closure (region x (Set.insert a I)) ∧
      F = closure (region y (Set.insert a' K)) ∧
      (∀ c : S, c ∉ I → F = closure (region x (Set.insert c I)) → c = a) ∧
      (∀ c : S, c ∉ K → F = closure (region y (Set.insert c K)) → c = a') ∧
      Set.insert a I = Set.insert a' K ∧
      component I a = component K a' ∧
      CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component I a) = CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component K a') ∧
      ∃ (hD : Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component I a)))
        (hD' : Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component K a'))),
        let forward := SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I a ha hD
        let reverse := SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs K a' ha' hD'
        forward.2.2 x = (y, K) ∧ reverse.2.2 y = (x, I) ∧
        K = Set.insert a I \ {a'} ∧ I = Set.insert a' K \ {a} ∧
        forward.1 * reverse.1 = (1 : W) ∧ reverse.1 * forward.1 = (1 : W)

UniversalWallGroupoid.type: ∀ {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S), CategoryTheory.Groupoid { p : W × Set S // Set.image (fun u : W => u * p.1) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J : Set W) = Set.image (fun u : W => p.1 * u) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs p.2 : Set W) ∧ CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep cs p.2 p.1 }
UniversalWallGroupoid.value:
fun {S W} _inst {M} cs J => {
  Hom := fun A B => { w : W // w = A.val.1⁻¹ * B.val.1 }
  id := fun A => ⟨1, (inv_mul_cancel A.val.1).symm⟩
  comp := fun {A B C} f g => ⟨f.val * g.val, by
    rw [f.property, g.property]
    simp only [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left]⟩
  id_comp := fun f => Subtype.ext (one_mul f.val)
  comp_id := fun f => Subtype.ext (mul_one f.val)
  assoc := fun f g h => Subtype.ext (mul_assoc f.val g.val h.val)
  inv := fun {A B} f => ⟨f.val⁻¹, by
    rw [f.property, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv]⟩
  inv_comp := fun f => Subtype.ext (inv_mul_cancel f.val)
  comp_inv := fun f => Subtype.ext (mul_inv_cancel f.val)
}

  let W := CoxeterMatrix.Group M

  let Label := { p : W × Set S //

      Set.image (fun u : W => p.1 * u) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs p.2 : Set W) ∧
    CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep cs p.2 p.1 }
  let component : Set S → S → Set S := fun I a =>
    { b | b ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b }
  let Step := { e : Label × S // e.2 ∉ e.1.val.2 ∧
    Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component e.1.val.2 e.2)) }
  let crossing := fun e : Step =>
    SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs e.val.1.val.2 e.val.2 e.property.1 e.property.2
  let path : Label → Label → List Step → Prop := fun p q es =>
    List.foldr
      (fun e tail r => r = e.val.1.val ∧ tail ((crossing e).2.2 e.val.1.val.1))
      (fun r => r = q.val) es p.val
  ∀ (p q : Label) (es : List Step), path p q es →
    ((∀ fs : List Step, path p q fs → List.length es ≤ List.length fs) ↔
      CoxeterSystem.length cs (List.prod (List.map (fun e => (crossing e).1) es)) =
        List.sum (List.map (fun e => CoxeterSystem.length cs (crossing e).1) es))

NormaliserChamberAction.type:
∀ {S : Type*} [Finite S] (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (J : Set S),
  let W := CoxeterMatrix.Group M
  let cs := CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem M
  let Label := { p : W × Set S //
    Set.image (fun u : W => u * p.1) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J : Set W) =
      Set.image (fun u : W => p.1 * u) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs p.2 : Set W) ∧
    CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep cs p.2 p.1 }
  let Θ := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.relativeSubspace J
  letI : TopologicalSpace Θ := TopologicalSpace.induced
    (fun f : Θ => ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates f.val)
    (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace (S → Real))
  let arrangement : Set (Submodule Real Θ) := (RelativeCone M J).2.2.2.2.2
  let face : Set S → Set (ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Dual S) := fun I =>
    { f | f ∈ ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.relativeSubspace I ∧
      ∀ i : S, i ∉ I → 0 < ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates f i }
  let region : Label → Set Θ := fun p =>
    { f | ∃ h : ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Dual S,
      h ∈ face p.val.2 ∧ ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualAction M p.val.1 h = f.val }
  let affineDimension : Set Θ → Nat := fun C =>
    Module.finrank Real (AffineSubspace.direction (affineSpan Real C))
  let wall : Set Θ → Set Θ → Prop := fun C F =>
    Set.Nonempty F ∧ ∃ H : Submodule Real Θ, H ∈ arrangement ∧
      F = closure C ∩ (H : Set Θ) ∧ affineDimension F + 1 = affineDimension C
  let adjacent : Label → Label → Prop := fun p q =>
    region p ≠ region q ∧ ∃ F : Set Θ, wall (region p) F ∧ wall (region q) F
  let component : Set S → S → Set S := fun I a =>
    { b | b ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b }
  let Norm := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.CoxeterNormalizer M J
  let N := ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterNormalizerQuotient M J
  let quotientMap : Norm → N := QuotientGroup.mk'
    ((ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).subgroupOf Norm)
  ∃ action : N →* Equiv.Perm Label,
    (∀ (g : Norm) (p : Label),
      let y := action (quotientMap g) p
      y.val.2 = p.val.2 ∧
      CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep cs p.val.2 y.val.1 ∧
      ∃ u : W, u ∈ CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs p.val.2 ∧
        y.val.1 = g.val * p.val.1 * u) ∧
    (∀ p q : Label, (∃ g : N, action g p = q) ↔ p.val.2 = q.val.2) ∧
    (∀ (g : N) (p : Label), action g p = p → g = 1) ∧
    (∀ (g : N) (p : Label),
      Set.image (ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.quotientRepresentation M J g) (region p) =
        region (action g p)) ∧
    (∀ (g : N) (p q : Label), adjacent p q → adjacent (action g p) (action g q)) ∧
    (∀ (g : N) (p q : Label), adjacent p q →
      ∀ (a : S) (ha : a ∉ p.val.2)
        (hD : Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component p.val.2 a))),
        (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs p.val.2 a ha hD).2.2 p.val.1 = q.val →
        (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs p.val.2 a ha hD).2.2 (action g p).val.1 =
          (action g q).val)

StandardGeodesicCorrespondence.type:
∀ {S W : Type*} [Finite S] [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
  (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S),
  let Obj := { I : Set S // ∃ g : W,
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g))
      (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs I) = CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J }
  let label : W → Set S → Prop := fun x I =>
    Set.image (fun u : W => u * x) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J : Set W) =
      Set.image (fun u : W => x * u) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs I : Set W) ∧
    CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep cs I x
  let component : Set S → S → Set S := fun I a =>
    { b | b ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b }
  let Atom := { p : Obj × S // p.2 ∉ p.1.val ∧
    Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component p.1.val p.2)) }
  let crossing := fun e : Atom =>
    SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs e.val.1.val e.val.2 e.property.1 e.property.2
  let Specified := { p : W × Atom // label p.1 p.2.val.1.val }
  let word : List Specified → List Atom := fun es => List.map (fun e => e.val.2) es
  let path : List Specified → (W × Set S) → (W × Set S) → Prop := fun es A B =>
    label A.1 A.2 ∧ label B.1 B.2 ∧
    List.foldr
      (fun e tail P => P = (e.val.1, e.val.2.val.1.val) ∧
        tail ((crossing e.val.2).2.2 e.val.1))
      (fun P => P = B) es A
  let geodesic : List Specified → (W × Set S) → (W × Set S) → Prop := fun es A B =>
    path es A B ∧ ∀ fs : List Specified, path fs A B → List.length es ≤ List.length fs
  (∀ (I K : Obj) (x y : W) (es : List Specified),
    geodesic es (x, I.val) (y, K.val) ↔
      path es (x, I.val) (y, K.val) ∧
      ∃ (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
        (e : StandardExpressions cs J I K w),
        w.val = x⁻¹ * y ∧ e.val = word es) ∧
  (∀ (I K : Obj) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (e : StandardExpressions cs J I K w) (x : W), label x I.val →
    ∃! es : List Specified,
      word es = e.val ∧ geodesic es (x, I.val) (x * w.val, K.val)) ∧
  (∀ (I K : Obj) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K),
    Nonempty (StandardExpressions cs J I K w)) ∧
  (∀ (I : Obj) (x : W), label x I.val →
    path List.nil (x, I.val) (x, I.val) ∧
    geodesic List.nil (x, I.val) (x, I.val) ∧ word List.nil = List.nil)

have candidate_triangle :
    let Obj := {L : Set S // ∃ g : W,
      Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g)) (cs.parabolic L) =

      (y : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom B C)

      (ey : StandardExpressions cs J B C y)

        (ez.val.length = ex.val.length + ey.val.length ↔

      let act := CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs
      let parallelClass : Obj → Finsupp S Real → Set (Finsupp S Real) := fun A α =>
        { β | β ∈ roots ∧ ∀ L, ∀ f : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom L A,

          c ⊆ ({ α | α ∈ roots ∧ 0 < α } ∩
            Set.image (act x) { α | α ∈ roots ∧ α < 0 }) }
      let count := fun (A : Obj) (x : W) => Nat.card { c // c ∈ classes A x }
      let N : W → Set (Finsupp S Real) := fun x =>

        induction hn : cs.length x using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing x with

              exact lt_asymm hp hm
            rw [hz]

          have hlen := cs.isLeftDescent_iff.1 hi
          have hf := ih (cs.length (cs.simple i * x)) (by omega) (cs.simple i * x) rfl
          apply (hf.image (M.geometricReflection i)).insert (Finsupp.single i 1) |>.subset

          · refine Or.inr ⟨M.geometricReflection i α, ?_, ?_⟩
            · refine ⟨(cs.geometricReflection_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff i).2 hα.1,

        apply (finite_N x.val).powerset.subset
        intro c hc
        change c ⊆ N x.val
        rw [image_N]
        exact hc.2
      have pc_self (A : Obj) {α : Finsupp S Real} (hr : α ∈ roots) :

      -- Parallel-root-classes steps 1.1, 2.1: full class transport in both directions.
      have pc_transport (A B : Obj) (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom A B)

            0 < act (f.val * x.val⁻¹) β) at h
          simpa only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, Representation.inv_self_apply] using h
      -- Parallel-root-classes step 3.1: identity and inverse tests give saturation.
      have saturated (A B : Obj) (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom A B)
          {α : Finsupp S Real} (hα : α ∈ N x.val) : parallelClass A α ⊆ N x.val := by
        intro β hβ
        have hp := hβ.2 A ((BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).id A)
        have hn := hβ.2 B ((BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).inv x)

        simp only [map_one, one_apply_eq_self] at hp
        have hp' : 0 < β := hp.mp hα.2.1
        have hr := (cs.geometricRepresentation_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff x.val⁻¹).2 hβ.1
        refine ⟨hβ.1, hp', ?_⟩
        apply (cs.pos_or_neg_of_mem_geometricRoots hr).resolve_left
        intro hb
        have ha : 0 < act x.val⁻¹ α := hn.mpr hb
        exact lt_asymm ha hα.2.2

        intro h

        ext c
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨⟨α, hr, rfl⟩, hs⟩
          exact ⟨α, (image_N x.val).symm ▸ hs (pc_self A hr.1), rfl⟩

            (image_N x.val) ▸ saturated A B x hα hβ⟩

          Disjoint (N x) (Set.image (act x) (N y)) := by
        have hprefix : N x ⊆ N (x * y) := by
          intro α hα
          exact ⟨hα.1, hα.2.1,
            ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.rootInversions_subset_of_length_eq_add_system cs x (x * y)

        have pos_transport {β : Finsupp S Real} (hβ : β ∈ N y) : 0 < act x β := by

          intro hn
          have hn' : -act x β ∈ N x := by
            refine ⟨(cs.neg_mem_geometricRoots_iff).2 hr, neg_pos.mpr hn, ?_⟩
            simpa [act] using (neg_neg_iff_pos.mpr hβ.2.1 : -β < 0)
          have h := (hprefix hn').2.2
          have hh : act (x * y)⁻¹ (-act x β) = -act y⁻¹ β := by
            simp [act, mul_inv_rev, map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp]
          rw [hh] at h
          exact lt_asymm (neg_pos.mpr hβ.2.2) h

        · ext α
          constructor
          · intro hα
            have hr := (cs.geometricRepresentation_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff x⁻¹).2 hα.1
            rcases cs.pos_or_neg_of_mem_geometricRoots hr with hp | hn
            · right
              refine ⟨act x⁻¹ α, ⟨hr, hp, ?_⟩, Representation.self_inv_apply _ _ _⟩

              simpa only [act, mul_inv_rev, map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp] using h

            · exact hprefix hα

          have hc := classes_image A D z

          rw [hc, classes_image A B x, classes_image B D y]

          ext c
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨α, ⟨β, hβ, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

          apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
          rintro c hc ⟨d, hd, hdc⟩
          rw [classes_image B D y] at hd

          have hm : act x.val β ∈ c := hdc ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem _ (pc_self B hβ.1)

        change classes A (x.val * y.val) = _ at hz

        rintro c ⟨α, hα, rfl⟩

    obtain ⟨j, hj, he⟩ := ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.transporter_conjugates_simple cs hc hm hi
    let v := cs.geometricRepresentation x (root i)
    have hneg : M.geometricReflection j v = -v := by
      have hprod : cs.simple j * x = x * cs.simple i := by rw [← he]; group
      calc
        _ = cs.geometricRepresentation (cs.simple j * x) (root i) := by
          rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, cs.geometricRepresentation_simple]
        _ = -v := by
          rw [hprod, cs.geometricRepresentation_mul_simple_single]
    have hr : v ∈ cs.geometricRoots := ⟨x, i, rfl⟩
    have hpos : 0 < v := (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_pos_iff x i).mpr
      (cs.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mp hm i hi)
    have hs : ∀ k, k ≠ j → v k = 0 := by
      intro k hk
      have hh := congrArg (fun z : S →₀ ℝ => z k) hneg
      rw [M.geometricReflection_apply_apply_of_ne hk] at hh
      change v k = -v k at hh
      linarith
    rcases cs.eq_single_or_eq_neg_single_of_mem_geometricRoots hr hs with hh | hh
    · exact ⟨j, hj, hh⟩
    · have hn : v j = -1 := by rw [hh]; simp
      have hp := hpos.le j
      change 0 ≤ v j at hp
      linarith
  have label_roots (x : W) (I : Set S) (hx : label x I) :
      cs.geometricRepresentation x '' piRoots I = piRoots J := by
    have hc := coset_conj x I hx.1
    have hci := ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.inverse_parabolic_transporter cs hc
    have hmi := ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.minimal_inv_of_parabolic_transporter cs hc hx.2
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨j, hj, he⟩ := transporter_root x I J hc hx.2 hi
      exact ⟨j, hj, he.symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨i, hi, he⟩ := transporter_root x⁻¹ J I hci hmi hj
      refine ⟨root i, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [← he, Representation.self_inv_apply]

  have root_conjugacy (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (g : W) (L F : Set S)
      (ht : cs.geometricRepresentation g ''
        ((fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' L) =
        (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' F) :
      (cs.parabolic L).map (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic F := by
    classical
    let act := cs.geometricRepresentation
    let root : S → (S →₀ ℝ) := fun i => Finsupp.single i 1
    have reflect (g : W) (i k : S) (h : act g (root i) = root k) :
        g * cs.simple i * g⁻¹ = cs.simple k := by
      apply cs.geometricRepresentation_injective
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro x
      have form : M.geometricForm (root i) (act g⁻¹ x) = M.geometricForm (root k) x := by
        calc
          _ = M.geometricForm (act g (root i)) (act g (act g⁻¹ x)) :=
            (cs.geometricForm_geometricRepresentation g (root i) (act g⁻¹ x)).symm
          _ = _ := by rw [h, Representation.self_inv_apply]
      change act (g * cs.simple i * g⁻¹) x = act (cs.simple k) x
      dsimp only [act, root] at h form ⊢
      simp only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, cs.geometricRepresentation_simple,
        M.geometricReflection_apply, map_sub, map_smul]
      rw [form, h, Representation.self_inv_apply]
    have genImage : (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom '' (cs.simple '' L) = cs.simple '' F := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨z, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        have hm : act g (root i) ∈ root '' F := ht ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem _ (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hi)
        obtain ⟨k, hk, he⟩ := hm
        exact ⟨k, hk, (reflect g i k he.symm).symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
        have hm : root k ∈ act g '' (root '' L) := ht.symm ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hk
        obtain ⟨x, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, he⟩ := hm
        exact ⟨cs.simple i, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, reflect g i k he⟩
    simp only [CoxeterSystem.parabolic, MonoidHom.map_closure, genImage]

  have c_literal_label_preserved {S W : Type _} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J I K : Set S) (x v : W)
      (hcos : (fun u : W => u * x) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
        (fun u : W => x * u) '' (cs.parabolic I : Set W))
      (hmin : cs.IsMinimalCosetRep I x)
      (hconj : (cs.parabolic K).map (MulAut.conj v).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic I)
      (hroots : cs.geometricRepresentation v ''
        ((fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' K) =
        (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' I) :
      (fun u : W => u * (x * v)) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
        (fun u : W => (x * v) * u) '' (cs.parabolic K : Set W) ∧
      cs.IsMinimalCosetRep K (x * v) := by
    constructor
    · ext r
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
        have hji : j * x ∈ (fun u : W => x * u) '' (cs.parabolic I : Set W) := hcos ▸ ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := hji
        change x * i = j * x at hxi
        rw [← hconj] at hi
        obtain ⟨k, hk, hki⟩ := hi
        change v * k * v⁻¹ = i at hki
        refine ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
        calc
          (x * v) * k = (x * i) * v := by rw [← hki]; group
          _ = j * (x * v) := by rw [hxi]; group
      · rintro ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
        have hi : v * k * v⁻¹ ∈ cs.parabolic I := by
          rw [← hconj]
          exact ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
        have hxj : x * (v * k * v⁻¹) ∈
            (fun u : W => u * x) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) :=
          hcos.symm ▸ ⟨v * k * v⁻¹, hi, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨j, hj, hjx⟩ := hxj
        change j * x = x * (v * k * v⁻¹) at hjx
        refine ⟨j, hj, ?_⟩
        calc
          j * (x * v) = (j * x) * v := by group
          _ = (x * (v * k * v⁻¹)) * v := by rw [hjx]
          _ = (x * v) * k := by group
    · apply cs.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mpr
      intro k hk
      have hr : cs.geometricRepresentation v (Finsupp.single k (1 : ℝ)) ∈
          (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' I :=
        hroots ▸ ⟨Finsupp.single k 1, ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨i, hi, heq⟩ := hr
      have hpos : 0 < cs.geometricRepresentation x (Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) :=
        (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_pos_iff x i).mpr (cs.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mp hmin i hi)
      apply (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_pos_iff (x * v) k).mp
      simpa only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, ← heq] using hpos
  constructor
  · intro I K x y hx hy
    have hxroot := label_roots x I.val hx
    have hyroot := label_roots y K.val hy
    refine ⟨⟨x⁻¹ * y, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    change cs.geometricRepresentation (x⁻¹ * y) '' piRoots K.val = piRoots I.val
    calc
      _ = cs.geometricRepresentation x⁻¹ ''
          (cs.geometricRepresentation y '' piRoots K.val) := by
        simp only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, Set.image_image]
      _ = cs.geometricRepresentation x⁻¹ ''
          (cs.geometricRepresentation x '' piRoots I.val) := by rw [hyroot, hxroot]
      _ = piRoots I.val := by
        simp only [Set.image_image, Representation.inv_self_apply, Set.image_id']
  · intro I K w x hx
    have hw : cs.geometricRepresentation w.val '' piRoots K.val = piRoots I.val := w.property
    have hc := root_conjugacy cs w.val K.val I.val hw
    have ht : label (x * w.val) K.val :=
      c_literal_label_preserved cs J I.val K.val x w.val hx.1 hx.2 hc hw
    refine ⟨ht, ⟨w.val, ?_⟩, rfl, ?_⟩
    · change w.val = x⁻¹ * (x * w.val)
      simp only [inv_mul_cancel_left]
    · intro f hf
      exact Subtype.ext hf

import ArtinDeligne

noncomputable def UniversalWallGroupoid : ∀ {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S), CategoryTheory.Groupoid { p : W × Set S // Set.image (fun u : W => u * p.1) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J : Set W) = Set.image (fun u : W => p.1 * u) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs p.2 : Set W) ∧ CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep cs p.2 p.1 } :=
fun {S W} _inst {M} cs J => {
  Hom := fun A B => { w : W // w = A.val.1⁻¹ * B.val.1 }
  id := fun A => ⟨1, (inv_mul_cancel A.val.1).symm⟩
  comp := fun {A B C} f g => ⟨f.val * g.val, by
    rw [f.property, g.property]
    simp only [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left]⟩
  id_comp := fun f => Subtype.ext (one_mul f.val)
  comp_id := fun f => Subtype.ext (mul_one f.val)
  assoc := fun f g h => Subtype.ext (mul_assoc f.val g.val h.val)
  inv := fun {A B} f => ⟨f.val⁻¹, by
    rw [f.property, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv]⟩
  inv_comp := fun f => Subtype.ext (inv_mul_cancel f.val)
  comp_inv := fun f => Subtype.ext (mul_inv_cancel f.val)
}

abbrev accepted_ChamberMorphismCorrespondence_type : Prop :=
∀ {S W : Type*} [Finite S] [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S),
  let Obj := { I : Set S // ∃ g : W,
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g))
      (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs I) = CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J }
  let label : W → Set S → Prop := fun x I =>
    Set.image (fun u : W => u * x) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J : Set W) =
      Set.image (fun u : W => x * u) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs I : Set W) ∧
    CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep cs I x
  (∀ (I K : Obj) (x y : W), label x I.val → label y K.val →
    ∃ f : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K, f.val = x⁻¹ * y) ∧
  (∀ (I K : Obj) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (x : W) (hx : label x I.val),
    ∃ htarget : label (x * w.val) K.val,
      ∃! f : (UniversalWallGroupoid cs J).Hom
        ⟨(x, I.val), hx⟩ ⟨(x * w.val, K.val), htarget⟩,
        f.val = w.val)

namespace GA
universe u v
variable {S : Type u} {W : Type v} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
abbrev Obj (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) :=
  { I : Set S // ∃ g : W, (cs.parabolic I).map (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic J }
abbrev Label (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) :=
  { p : W × Set S // Set.image (fun u : W => u * p.1) (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
    Set.image (fun u : W => p.1 * u) (cs.parabolic p.2 : Set W) ∧
    cs.IsMinimalCosetRep p.2 p.1 }
abbrev component (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (I : Set S) (a : S) :=
  { b | b ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
    (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b }
abbrev Atom (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) :=
  { e : Obj cs J × S // e.2 ∉ e.1.val ∧ Finite (cs.parabolic (component M e.1.val e.2)) }
abbrev Step (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) :=
  { e : Label cs J × S // e.2 ∉ e.1.val.2 ∧ Finite (cs.parabolic (component M e.1.val.2 e.2)) }
noncomputable abbrev cross (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (e : Atom cs J) :=
  SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs e.val.1.val e.val.2 e.property.1 e.property.2
noncomputable abbrev scross (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (e : Step cs J) :=
  SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs e.val.1.val.2 e.val.2 e.property.1 e.property.2
abbrev composable (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (es : List (Atom cs J)) (I K : Set S) :=
  List.foldr (fun e tail L => L = e.val.1.val ∧ tail (cross cs J e).2.1)
    (fun L => L = K) es I
noncomputable abbrev product (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (es : List (Atom cs J)) :=
  (es.map (fun e => (cross cs J e).1)).prod
noncomputable abbrev weight (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (es : List (Atom cs J)) :=
  (es.map (fun e => cs.length (cross cs J e).1)).sum
noncomputable abbrev path (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S)
    (p q : Label cs J) (es : List (Step cs J)) :=
  List.foldr (fun e tail r => r = e.val.1.val ∧ tail ((scross cs J e).2.2 e.val.1.val.1))
    (fun r => r = q.val) es p.val
noncomputable def canonical (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S)
    (I K : Obj cs J) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K) :=
  Classical.choice (StandardFactorCount cs J I K w).1
noncomputable def d (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S)
    (I K : Obj cs J) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K) : Nat :=
  (canonical cs J I K w).val.length

theorem standard_count (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S)
    (I K : Obj cs J) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (e : StandardExpressions cs J I K w) : e.val.length = d cs J I K w := by
  exact ((StandardFactorCount cs J I K w).2.2 e).trans
    ((StandardFactorCount cs J I K w).2.2 (canonical cs J I K w)).symm

noncomputable def toObj (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (p : Label cs J) : Obj cs J :=
  ⟨p.val.2, ⟨p.val.1, by
    ext u
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      have hm : p.val.1 * v ∈ Set.image (fun u : W => p.val.1 * u)
          (cs.parabolic p.val.2 : Set W) := ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      rw [← p.property.1] at hm
      obtain ⟨z, hz, he⟩ := hm
      have he' : p.val.1 * v * p.val.1⁻¹ = z := by
        rw [← he, mul_inv_cancel_right]
      change p.val.1 * v * p.val.1⁻¹ ∈ cs.parabolic J
      rw [he']
      exact hz
    · intro hu
      have hm : u * p.val.1 ∈ Set.image (fun u : W => u * p.val.1)
          (cs.parabolic J : Set W) := ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
      rw [p.property.1] at hm
      obtain ⟨v, hv, he⟩ := hm
      refine ⟨v, hv, ?_⟩
      change p.val.1 * v * p.val.1⁻¹ = u
      change p.val.1 * v = u * p.val.1 at he
      rw [he, mul_inv_cancel_right]⟩⟩
noncomputable abbrev toAtom (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (e : Step cs J) : Atom cs J :=
  ⟨(toObj cs J e.val.1, e.val.2), e.property⟩

theorem cross_toAtom (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (e : Step cs J) :
    cross cs J (toAtom cs J e) = scross cs J e := rfl

abbrev Triangle (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) : Prop :=
  ∀ (I K L : Obj cs J) (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (y : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom K L),
    d cs J I L ((BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).comp x y) ≤ d cs J I K x + d cs J K L y ∧
    (d cs J I L ((BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).comp x y) = d cs J I K x + d cs J K L y ↔
      cs.length (x.val * y.val) = cs.length x.val + cs.length y.val)

end GA
abbrev candidate_triangle_type : Prop :=
  ∀ {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S),
    GA.Triangle cs J
namespace GA
universe u v
variable {S : Type u} {W : Type v} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
theorem weight_bound (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (es : List (Atom cs J)) :
    cs.length (product cs J es) ≤ weight cs J es := by
  induction es with
  | nil => simp [product, weight]
  | cons e es ih =>
    change cs.length ((cross cs J e).1 * product cs J es) ≤
      cs.length (cross cs J e).1 + weight cs J es
    exact (cs.length_mul_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_left ih _)

-- Local implementation helper only; parent Proposition 3.29, p.13--14.
-- Portal inspiration: step 2.1 (nonnegative length deficits).
theorem word_metric (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (ht : Triangle cs J) :
    ∀ (es : List (Atom cs J)) (A B : Obj cs J)
      (f : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom A B),
      composable cs J es A.val B.val → product cs J es = f.val →
      d cs J A B f ≤ es.length ∧
      (d cs J A B f = es.length ↔ cs.length f.val = weight cs J es) := by
  intro es
  induction es with
  | nil =>
    intro A B f hc hp
    let hstd : StandardExpressions cs J A B f :=
      ⟨[], hc, hp, by simpa only [product, List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, List.sum_nil] using
        (congrArg cs.length hp).symm.trans (cs.length_one)⟩
    have hd : 0 = d cs J A B f := by
      simpa only [hstd, List.length_nil] using standard_count cs J A B f hstd
    have hf : f.val = 1 := hp.symm
    simp only [List.length_nil] at hd ⊢
    exact ⟨by omega, by simp [← hd, hf, weight]⟩
  | cons e es ih =>
    intro A B f hc hp
    change A.val = e.val.1.val ∧ composable cs J es (cross cs J e).2.1 B.val at hc
    have hAe : A = e.val.1 := Subtype.ext hc.1
    subst A
    obtain ⟨htarget, x, hx⟩ := ElementaryWallMorphism cs J e.val.1.val
      e.val.1.property e.val.2 e.property.1 e.property.2
    let T : Obj cs J := ⟨(cross cs J e).2.1, htarget⟩
    change (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom e.val.1 T at x
    change x.val = (cross cs J e).1 at hx
    let y : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom T B :=
      (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).comp ((BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).inv x) f
    have hy : y.val = product cs J es := by
      change x.val⁻¹ * f.val = product cs J es
      change (cross cs J e).1 * product cs J es = f.val at hp
      rw [hx, ← hp, inv_mul_cancel_left]
    have hf : f.val = x.val * y.val := by
      change f.val = x.val * (x.val⁻¹ * f.val)
      simp
    have hcomp : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).comp x y = f := Subtype.ext hf.symm
    let hstd : StandardExpressions cs J e.val.1 T x :=
      ⟨[e], ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, by simpa only [product, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one] using hx.symm,
        by change cs.length x.val = cs.length (cross cs J e).1 + 0; rw [hx, add_zero]⟩
    have hxcount : d cs J e.val.1 T x = 1 := by
      simpa only [hstd, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] using
        (standard_count cs J _ _ x hstd).symm
    have htri := ht e.val.1 T B x y
    rw [hcomp, hxcount] at htri
    have hrec := ih T B y hc.2 hy.symm
    have hb := weight_bound cs J es
    have hm := cs.length_mul_le x.val y.val
    rw [← hy] at hb
    rw [← hf] at hm
    change d cs J e.val.1 B f ≤ es.length + 1 ∧
      (d cs J e.val.1 B f = es.length + 1 ↔
        cs.length f.val = cs.length (cross cs J e).1 + weight cs J es)
    refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
    constructor
    · intro heq
      have htEq : d cs J e.val.1 B f = 1 + d cs J T B y := by omega
      have hyEq : d cs J T B y = es.length := by omega
      have hlen := htri.2.mp htEq
      rw [← hf, hx, hrec.2.mp hyEq] at hlen
      exact hlen
    · intro hlen
      have htail : cs.length y.val = weight cs J es := by rw [hx] at hm; omega
      have hxy : cs.length (x.val * y.val) = cs.length x.val + cs.length y.val := by
        rw [← hf, hx, htail]; exact hlen
      have htEq := htri.2.mpr hxy
      have hyEq := hrec.2.mpr htail
      omega
end GA

-- Portal step 1.1 supplies the inspiration for endpoint telescoping.
theorem path_word (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S)
    (p q : Label cs J) (es : List (Step cs J)) (hp : path cs J p q es) :
    composable cs J (es.map (toAtom cs J)) p.val.2 q.val.2 ∧
    product cs J (es.map (toAtom cs J)) = p.val.1⁻¹ * q.val.1 := by
  have aux : ∀ (es : List (Step cs J)) (r : W × Set S),
      List.foldr (fun e tail r => r = e.val.1.val ∧
        tail ((scross cs J e).2.2 e.val.1.val.1)) (fun r => r = q.val) es r →
      composable cs J (es.map (toAtom cs J)) r.2 q.val.2 ∧
      r.1 * product cs J (es.map (toAtom cs J)) = q.val.1 := by
    intro es
    induction es with
    | nil =>
      intro r hr
      change r = q.val at hr
      subst r
      exact ⟨rfl, mul_one _⟩
    | cons e es ih =>
      intro r hr
      change r = e.val.1.val ∧ _ at hr
      obtain ⟨hc, hprod⟩ := ih ((scross cs J e).2.2 e.val.1.val.1) hr.2
      rw [hr.1]
      constructor
      · exact ⟨rfl, hc⟩
      · change e.val.1.val.1 * ((scross cs J e).1 *
          product cs J (es.map (toAtom cs J))) = q.val.1
        change (e.val.1.val.1 * (scross cs J e).1) *
          product cs J (es.map (toAtom cs J)) = q.val.1 at hprod
        rw [← mul_assoc]
        exact hprod
  obtain ⟨hc, he⟩ := aux es p.val hp
  refine ⟨hc, ?_⟩
  rw [← he, inv_mul_cancel_left]

-- Lifts a composable atom list with prescribed endpoints. Empty lists are included.
-- Local implementation helper for Proposition 3.29, pp.13--14; arrow preservation
-- is the explicitly quantified Proposition 4.6 premise, not an assumed theorem.
theorem lift_word [Finite S] (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S)
    (cmc : accepted_ChamberMorphismCorrespondence_type.{u,v}) :
    ∀ (es : List (Atom cs J)) (A B : Obj cs J) (p q : Label cs J),
      p.val.2 = A.val → q.val.2 = B.val →
      p.val.1 * product cs J es = q.val.1 → composable cs J es A.val B.val →
      ∃ fs : List (Step cs J), path cs J p q fs ∧ fs.length = es.length := by
  intro es
  induction es with
  | nil =>
    intro A B p q hp hq he hc
    have hpq : p.val = q.val := by
      apply Prod.ext
      · simpa only [product, List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, mul_one] using he
      · exact hp.trans (hc.trans hq.symm)
    exact ⟨[], hpq, rfl⟩
  | cons e es ih =>
    intro A B p q hp hq he hc
    change A.val = e.val.1.val ∧ composable cs J es (cross cs J e).2.1 B.val at hc
    have hpe : p.val.2 = e.val.1.val := hp.trans hc.1
    obtain ⟨hT, x, hx⟩ := ElementaryWallMorphism cs J e.val.1.val e.val.1.property
      e.val.2 e.property.1 e.property.2
    let T : Obj cs J := ⟨(cross cs J e).2.1, hT⟩
    change (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom e.val.1 T at x
    have hlabel := p.property
    rw [hpe] at hlabel
    obtain ⟨hr, _⟩ := (cmc (S := S) (W := W) (M := M) cs J).2 e.val.1 T x p.val.1 hlabel
    rw [hx] at hr
    let r : Label cs J := ⟨(p.val.1 * (cross cs J e).1, T.val), hr⟩
    have htail : r.val.1 * product cs J es = q.val.1 := by
      change (p.val.1 * (cross cs J e).1) * product cs J es = q.val.1
      rw [mul_assoc]
      exact he
    obtain ⟨fs, hfs, hlen⟩ := ih T B r q rfl hq htail hc.2
    let s : Step cs J := ⟨(p, e.val.2), by simpa only [hpe] using e.property⟩
    have hcross : (scross cs J s).2.2 p.val.1 = r.val := by
      have hsource : toObj cs J p = e.val.1 := Subtype.ext hpe
      have ha : toAtom cs J s = e := by apply Subtype.ext; exact Prod.ext hsource rfl
      change (cross cs J (toAtom cs J s)).2.2 p.val.1 = r.val
      rw [ha]
      rfl
    refine ⟨s :: fs, ?_, by simpa only [List.length_cons, hlen]⟩
    change p.val = p.val ∧ _
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [hcross]
    exact hfs
end GA

∀ {S : Type u} [Finite S] (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (J : Set S),
  let W := CoxeterMatrix.Group M

namespace RootClassTriangle
variable {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
variable (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S)

/-- Internal bridge using the completed StandardFactorCount prerequisite. -/
theorem standard_length_eq_card (A B : Objects cs J)
    (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom A B)
    (e : StandardExpressions cs J A B x) :
    e.val.length = (family cs J A x.val).ncard := by
  exact (StandardFactorCount cs J A B x).2.2 e

/-- The root-class triangle inequality for any three standard expressions. -/
theorem standard_length_triangle (A B D : Objects cs J)
    (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom A B)
    (y : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom B D)
    (ex : StandardExpressions cs J A B x)
    (ey : StandardExpressions cs J B D y)
    (ez : StandardExpressions cs J A D ((BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).comp x y)) :
    ez.val.length ≤ ex.val.length + ey.val.length ∧
    (ez.val.length = ex.val.length + ey.val.length ↔
      cs.length (x.val * y.val) = cs.length x.val + cs.length y.val) := by
  rw [standard_length_eq_card cs J A B x ex,
    standard_length_eq_card cs J B D y ey,
    standard_length_eq_card cs J A D _ ez]
  exact ⟨card_triangle cs J A B D x y, card_eq_iff_add cs J A B D x y⟩

end RootClassTriangle

by
  classical
  /-
  Proposition 3.29, printed pp.13–14, https://arxiv.org/pdf/2509.21915#page=13.
  Numbered inspiration: GeodesicAdditivity 1.1 (endpoint products telescope)
  and 2.1 (word induction and nonnegative ambient length deficits):
  https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/artin-tits-normalisers-2509-21915/item-prop-geodesic-additivity-artin-tits-normalisers.
  Necessary departure from the geometric route in 1.1/3.1: use the completed
  algebraic StandardFactorCount and the proved triangle/equality criterion.
  General containment, disjointness and whole-class cancellation below prove
  that criterion without presuming positivity of transported classes. The
  actual chamber-arrow correspondence supplies both endpoint arrows and the
  lift of a canonical standard word. These local implementation blocks have
  no separate original standalone article statements. Their parent results
  are this proposition and Lemma 4.10/Corollary 4.13, printed p.18.
  All helper-round premises are discharged by local proofs below. The final
  comparison uses the canonical lifted word to attain the lower bound, and
  handles the empty list in both word induction and lifting.
  The finite-rank hypothesis is the accepted user-directed convention; no
  finite ambient Coxeter group or spherical-source hypothesis is introduced.
  Source reading: the complete relevant portal entries, parent article context
  and completed internal source blocks were consulted; broader full-article
  and graph investigations are reused only as recorded in the prior reports.
  The Proposition 4.6 proof typo (left descent) is addressed in provedCMC
  through the correctly oriented imported inverse-minimality result; see
  https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/artin-tits-normalisers-2509-21915/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects#pdf-prop46-left-descent-typo--confirmed.
  It requires no change to either accepted endpoint. No translation review.
  -/
  /- Completed internal BrinkHowlettGroupoid: included locally; no new prerequisite. -/
  let BrinkHowlettGroupoid : (∀ {S W : Type _} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S), CategoryTheory.Groupoid { I : Set S // ∃ w : W, Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj w)) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs I) = CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J }) :=
  (by
    intro S W inst M cs J
    let roots : Set S → Set (Finsupp S Real) :=
      fun I => Set.image (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) I
    exact {
      Hom := fun I K => { w : W //
        Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs w) (roots K.val) = roots I.val }
      id := fun I => ⟨1, by simp⟩
      comp := fun {I K L} x y => ⟨x.val * y.val, by
        calc
          Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs (x.val * y.val)) (roots L.val)
              = Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val)
                  (Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs y.val) (roots L.val)) := by
                    simp only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, Set.image_image]
          _ = roots I.val := by rw [y.property, x.property]⟩
      id_comp := fun x => Subtype.ext (one_mul x.val)
      comp_id := fun x => Subtype.ext (mul_one x.val)
      assoc := fun x y z => Subtype.ext (mul_assoc x.val y.val z.val)
      inv := fun {I K} x => ⟨x.val⁻¹, by
        calc
          Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val⁻¹) (roots I.val)
              = Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val⁻¹)
                  (Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val) (roots K.val)) :=
                    congrArg (Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val⁻¹)) x.property.symm
          _ = roots K.val := by
            simp only [Set.image_image, Representation.inv_self_apply, Set.image_id']⟩
      inv_comp := fun x => Subtype.ext (inv_mul_cancel x.val)
      comp_inv := fun x => Subtype.ext (mul_inv_cancel x.val)
    })
  /- Completed internal ElementaryWallMorphism: included locally; no new prerequisite. -/
  have ElementaryWallMorphism : (∀ {S W : Type _} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J I : Set S) (hI : ∃ w : W, Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj w)) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs I) = CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J) (a : S) (ha : a ∉ I), let D : Set S := {b | b ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b}; ∀ hD : Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs D), let crossing := SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I a ha hD; ∃ hK : ∃ w : W, Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj w)) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs crossing.2.1) = CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J, ∃ f : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom ⟨I, hI⟩ ⟨crossing.2.1, hK⟩, f.val = crossing.1) :=
  (by
    /- Lemma 4.2, printed p. 15, https://arxiv.org/pdf/2509.21915#page=15.
    Alphabeta inspiration: steps 1.1, 2.1, 3.1, 4.1 of
    https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/artin-tits-normalisers-2509-21915/item-lem-wall-is-morphism-artin-tits-normalisers.
    No rank restriction is introduced. The following local opposition argument is a new
    implementation helper, not a separately stated article theorem; its parents are
    Notation 2.5 / (2.6), printed p. 5, and Lemma 4.2. In place of step 1.1's restriction
    route, we use reduced parabolic words and their finitely supported root vectors.
    Thus the existing finite-index restriction APIs are never applied at infinite rank.
    Literature gap: the article proof says 'Since I, K are both finite and since |I|=|K|'.
    This is unavailable here: I and K can be infinite although W_D is finite. Steps
    2.1--3.1 below supply explicit inverse index witnesses, so no cardinality inference
    is used. This is a proof repair, not a change of endpoint.
    The supplied defect report, finding pdf-wall-root-characterisation,
    https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/artin-tits-normalisers-2509-21915/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects#pdf-wall-root-characterisation,
    rejects the auxiliary root inclusion after (3.15), printed p. 10 (its rank-one
    counterexample has I empty). We never use it; the longest-element definition remains.
    The prior source/graph investigations are reused as reports, not represented as fresh
    full-article or full-dependency reading. Current reading covers the parent Lemma 4.2,
    its surrounding definitions, the complete numbered portal proof, and the cited defect.
    Local source search found the actual arbitrary-rank root/word APIs used below;
    a fresh bounded GitHub search for geometricRepresentation_single_neg_iff language:Lean
    returned zero results, and the pinned mathlib Coxeter search found no opposition endpoint.
    Neither is an exhaustive absence claim. -/
    intro S W inst M cs J I hI a ha D hD
    have oppositionWork (L : Set S) (z : cs.parabolic L)
        (hz : ∀ u : cs.parabolic L, cs.length (u : W) ≤ cs.length (z : W)) :
        (z : W) * z = 1 ∧ ∃ e : L ≃ L, Function.Involutive e ∧
          (∀ i : L, cs.geometricRepresentation (z : W) (Finsupp.single (i : S) 1) =
            -Finsupp.single (e i : S) 1) ∧
          (∀ i : L, (z : W) * cs.simple (i : S) * (z : W)⁻¹ = cs.simple (e i : S)) := by
      classical
      let act := cs.geometricRepresentation
      let root : S → S →₀ ℝ := fun i => Finsupp.single i 1
      have outside (w : W) (hw : w ∈ cs.parabolic L) (k : S) (hk : k ∉ L)
          (x : S →₀ ℝ) : act w x k = x k := by
        obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_wordProd_eq_of_mem_parabolic hw
        induction u with
        | nil => simp [act]
        | cons i u ih =>
          have hki : k ≠ i := fun h => hk (h ▸ hu i (by simp))
          simp only [cs.wordProd_cons, map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp]
          rw [cs.geometricRepresentation_simple, M.geometricReflection_apply_apply_of_ne hki]
          exact ih (fun j hj => hu j (by simp [hj])) (cs.wordProd_mem_parabolic (fun j hj => hu j (by simp [hj])))
      have desc (i : S) (hi : i ∈ L) : cs.length ((z : W) * cs.simple i) + 1 = cs.length z := by
        have h := hz ⟨_, (cs.parabolic L).mul_mem z.property (cs.simple_mem_parabolic hi)⟩
        change cs.length ((z : W) * cs.simple i) ≤ cs.length (z : W) at h
        rcases cs.length_mul_simple (z : W) i with h' | h' <;> omega
      have cols (i : S) (hi : i ∈ L) : act (z : W) (root i) ≤ 0 :=
        ((cs.geometricRepresentation_single_neg_iff (z : W) i).mpr (by
          change cs.length ((z : W) * cs.simple i) < cs.length (z : W)
          have := desc i hi
          omega)).le
      have nonpos (x : S →₀ ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hs : ∀ k, k ∉ L → x k = 0) :
          act (z : W) x ≤ 0 := by
        have he : x = ∑ i ∈ x.support, x i • root i := by
          ext k
          simp [root, Finsupp.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
        rw [he, map_sum]
        intro k
        simp only [Finset.sum_apply', map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply,
          Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
        apply Finset.sum_nonpos
        intro i hi
        have hiL : i ∈ L := by
          by_contra hn
          exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi) (hs i hn)
        exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (hx i) (cols i hiL k)
      have len (u : W) (hu : u ∈ cs.parabolic L) :
          cs.length ((z : W) * u) + cs.length u = cs.length z := by
        obtain ⟨v, hv, hL, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced_wordProd_eq_of_mem_parabolic hu
        have H : ∀ v : List S, cs.IsReduced v → (∀ i ∈ v, i ∈ L) →
            cs.length ((z : W) * cs.wordProd v) + v.length = cs.length z := by
          intro v
          induction v using List.reverseRecOn with
          | nil => simp
          | append_singleton v i ih =>
            intro hred hL
            have hrv : cs.IsReduced v := by simpa only [List.take_left] using hred.take v.length
            have hvL : ∀ j ∈ v, j ∈ L := fun j hj => hL j (by simp [hj])
            have hiL := hL i (by simp)
            have hp := ih hrv hvL
            have has : cs.length (cs.wordProd v * cs.simple i) = cs.length (cs.wordProd v) + 1 := by
              simpa only [cs.wordProd_append, cs.wordProd_singleton, List.length_append,
                List.length_singleton, hrv.eq] using hred.eq
            have hpos : 0 < act (cs.wordProd v) (root i) :=
              (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_pos_iff _ _).mpr (by
                change ¬ cs.length (cs.wordProd v * cs.simple i) < cs.length (cs.wordProd v)
                omega)
            have hs : ∀ k, k ∉ L → act (cs.wordProd v) (root i) k = 0 := by
              intro k hk
              rw [outside _ (cs.wordProd_mem_parabolic hvL) k hk]
              simp [root, show i ≠ k from fun h => hk (h ▸ hiL)]
            have hn := nonpos _ hpos.le hs
            have hneg : act ((z : W) * cs.wordProd v) (root i) < 0 := by
              refine lt_of_le_of_ne ?_ ?_
              · simpa only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp] using hn
              · exact (cs.ne_zero_of_mem_geometricRoots ⟨_, i, rfl⟩)
            have hd := (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_neg_iff _ i).mp hneg
